finding.title: Integer Overflow or Wraparound
finding.untrusted_source: cin >> n; cin >> m; cin >> k; cin >> h;
finding.trigger: If n, m, k, or h are large enough, abs(v[i] - h) could overflow.
finding.assumptions: The values of n, m, k, and h are not validated to ensure they are within a safe range.

finding.title: OS Command Injection
finding.trigger: Although not directly evident, if v[i] is used in a command execution later in the code, this could lead to OS command injection.
finding.assumptions: The code may interact with the operating system in a way that v[i] is used in a command execution.

finding.title: Use of Hard-coded Credentials
finding.sink: if (x == 0) { x = v[i] / k; if (x < m) { ans++; } }
finding.trigger: If v[i], k, or m are manipulated to bypass the condition, it could be a security issue.
finding.assumptions: The values of v[i], k, and m are not validated or sanitized properly, potentially leading to a security issue.

finding.title: Integer Overflow or Wraparound
finding.sink: x = v[i] % k; x = v[i] / k;
finding.trigger: If v[i] or k are large enough, the operations x = v[i] % k and x = v[i] / k could overflow.
finding.assumptions: The values of v[i] and k are not validated to ensure they are within a safe range.
